cwdResolution: project root: the directory that contains this plan, generated/hello-world.mjs and test/
envResolution: no variables are added or required; the command inherits the invoking environment and needs no package installation
expectedTestPassCountMeaning: floor: the component and UAT coverage floor; the observed pass count must be at least this value
representationChanges: The original test_execution_plan stage produced test-execution-plan.json and test-execution-result.json and had the worker run the command. Under the installed lifecycle this plan is written without a result file: the execution result is the admitted observation of running this plan's command, args and cwd, judged against expectedExitCode, expectedTestPassCount, expectedTestFailCount and expectedStdoutMatch.
expectedStdoutMatch is a list of fragments that stdout must contain. It holds only the zero-failure fragment and no pass-count fragment, because the tests add depth cases above the 2-test floor.
